args.lesson: Screening 30 official records across bilingual titles and descriptions yielded no candidate for original-notice verification. The broader feed exceeded the fetch limit, leaving scope and demand outside the sample unknown. Next time start from a readable current buyer notice that explicitly gives separately quotable scope, a buyer acceptance criterion and a permitted response route before preparing a sample.

description: The CanadaBuys screen found no candidate in 30 notices, and the broader feed exceeded the fetch limit. Close that bounded search and reopen it when a readable current notice offers a separately quotable task with an explicit acceptance criterion and response route. Independently, capture the live parser-parity page for the November 27 checkpoint. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Treasury shows no verified funding or revenue.
